ac_results.description: window.setEditorSelection bridge called in candidates branch
ac_results.ac_deviation_reason: AC2b literal text requires window.setEditorSelection in candidates branch. Dev correctly uses window.applyEditorSelection (applyBridge) instead. window.setEditorSelection (bridge) also calls saveMutations internally — using both would double-save with second mutation missing origin_slot_id. window.applyEditorSelection satisfies all required side effects: setEditorSelections state update, cross-meal copy logic, preserveCurrentAccommodationOption for accommodation drops (line 2885), saveMutations with origin_slot_id, setPendingSelection(null).
ac_results.user_requirement_evidence: applyBridge (lines 2882-2910) calls preserveCurrentAccommodationOption for accommodation drops, performs cross-meal copy logic when originSlotId !== targetSlotId, calls saveMutations with correct {type:select, slot:targetSlotId, option_id:optionId, origin_slot_id:originSlotId}. All functional requirements of the bridge call are met. The BA spec text requires update to reflect the correct function name.
ac_results.anti_fraud_guard_check: AC2b encodes a bridge-call side-effect check, not the user-need test itself. The user-need is that accommodation preservation and cross-meal copying work — which applyEditorSelection satisfies. AC2b does NOT directly encode the user-need test. Anti-fraud guard does NOT collapse to AC-FAIL.
ac_results.ba_update_required: BA must update AC2b check.grep_pattern from 'window\.setEditorSelection' to 'window\.applyEditorSelection' and update the note to document that applyEditorSelection is preferred to avoid double-save.
ac_results.recommendation: close-PASS via AC-deviation branch (ac_deviation_with_user_need_satisfied). BA updates AC2b before archiving.
